Constants/PermissionLevel.luau.description: Permission Level provides the class/model implementation used by the Permissionservice package.

PermissionServiceClient/Providers/Permis.description: Holds the admin status the server pushed over [PermissionServiceNetwork]. See [PermissionServiceClient]. Only the local player's permissions are ever replicated, so this provider answers for the local player alone. Public entry points include `PermissionProviderClient.new`, `PermissionProviderClient.PromiseIsAdmin`, `PermissionProviderClient.PromiseIsUserAdmin`, `PermissionProviderClient.ObserveIsAdmin`,…

PermissionServiceClient/init.luau.description: Provides permissions on the client. See [PermissionService] for more details. Read-only: permissions are decided on the server and pushed down, so there is no setter here. Be sure to initialize the [PermissionService] on the server.

Shared/PermissionServiceNetwork.luau.description: Replicates a player's admin status from [PermissionService] to The server resolves permissions as each player joins and pushes that player their own status over `permissionsLoaded`. The server never listens for it, so a client firing it does nothing. To ask about somebody else, the client invokes the `isAdmin` query.
